title: Nature's Own Magnesium Glycinate 1150mg 300 Tablets $29.99 + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store) @ Chemist Warehouse
body:
Deal: Nature's Own Magnesium Glycinate 1150mg 300 Tablets $29.99 + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store) @ Chemist Warehouse

[anttheknee] Cracking price! If needing it delivered and you have Amazon Prime, Amazon has this for $33.32 delivered.
[SuperScope] Amazons listing is for 200 tablets whereas Chemist Warehouse is 300
[enander] Excellent price, I paid around $44 last week.
[HaydosK] Is this a worse product? https://www.chemistwarehouse.com.au/buy/163893/natures-way-m…
[HaydosK] No but people are calling this a massive deal when this is the same but cheaper?
[randomdude14] Valid question. Looks better given the Mg content is slightly higher too
[Jolakot] I've used both, Nature's Own is worth a few bucks more imo, the tablets are much easier to take. Found the Nature Way ones get stuck in your throat, while Nature's Own slides easily especially taking 2x at once.
[mecind] Get $3 cashback with shopback throught receipt?
[oatmatcha] Has anyone used this and the Vitaceuticals one (more expensive) and noticed any difference?
[McMaferMur] Or compare with the cheaper one linked above, Noticed any difference?
[tinsoldier] Anyone who is new to this be warned to strap yourself in for magnesium dreams, you may see things you’ll never forget.
